context: Sho and Hina cool off with a fan.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: しょう、扇風機、こっち、向ける？
lines.en: Sho, will you point the fan this way?
lines.style: Bright, eager eight-year-old opening. Slightly breathless with excitement. Soft confidence—she knows he'll help. Warm and genuine, no performance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Small, genuine six-year-old warmth. Quiet delight in the simple cool air. Soft exhale of contentment. Real, unperformed appreciation.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Summer is hot, but it's fun.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Child's voice finding something true about the season. Warm, gentle rhythm. Small philosophical note without overthinking.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 一緒に、アイス、食べよう。
lines.style: Soft, six-year-old proposal. Quiet warmth underneath—inclusion matters more than the treat. Small smile audible. Genuine, not performing enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bright eight-year-old joy with real depth. Opening attack of pure delight. Bouncy but not shrill. Genuine warmth sustained through to the end.
